paragraphs.text: Skaal Kesh is a zombie dragon from Jund , Alara , raised into undeath by the necromancy of Meren of Clan Nel Toth.

When Meren returned to Jund , she wanted vengeance. Vengeance for appointing her to her trial too early, for casting her out, for leaving her to die. And most of all, she wanted to kill her old master, Kael . Skaal Kesh would be her path to victory, an unhallowed creature full of raw power. She tracked down the new location of her people's camp, and there he was. Kael put up a fight, but Meren was by far stronger, and she fed Kael to Skaal Kesh. But she was not done. She would not rest until all the cairns of Jund had been toppled.
